prevention_rule: Every material website candidate must include Brain learning, development ledger and human-readable change documentation in the same lineage; changed static blog pages must avoid non-essential third-party runtime loads when the Lighthouse gate applies.

tests: Canonical shell, page/SEO and V18 promotion gates succeeded before the closure repair.
evidence.outcome: Candidate updated to remove non-essential third-party loads and carry required closure artifacts; exact-head gates must rerun before merge.
evidence.production_readback: Pending exact-head protected merge and production readback.
